pr_title: [collector/slabinfo] Fix pagesize not defined in non-x86 arches
pr_body:
##### Summary
Makes pagesize dynamic at startup instead of fixed at compile time

Some arches does not export PAGE_SIZE in `<sys/user.h>`.
ARM (raspberry pi) provides `/usr/include/arm-linux-gnueabihf/sys/user.h` which does not provide it.
 
Changed `#define` to `static long` fetched from POSIX `sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE)` (defined in `<unistd.h>`) [manpage](http://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man3/sysconf.3.html)

##### Component Name
collectors/slabinfo.plugin

##### Additional Information
Fixes #6896 : Fail to build on raspberry pi

comments:
Hello,

Deeply sorry you had to experience this @realEthanZou 

The PAGE_SIZE value should have been declared in `/usr/include/sys/user.h` but from [this thread](https://lists.debian.org/debian-glibc/2006/10/msg00169.html) it seems not all arches export this as a fixed value, as it's sometimes dynamic.
I've downloaded rapsbian and the sys/user.h used is in `/usr/include/arm-linux-gnueabihf/sys/user.h` and indeed does not export PAGE_SIZE.

I'm working on the fix for non-x86 arches.

In the meantime, you should be able to workaround this with:
```
sed -e "s/ PAGE_SIZE/ $(getconf PAGESIZE)/g" -i collectors/slabinfo.plugin/slabinfo.c
make
```
